rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: gs_n_iter=500, gs_n_gaussians=192, gs_outer_wall_s=1500, gs_lr_pos=0.0005, train_n=2, val_n=2, rationale=iter-14: KNOB=gs_n_gaussians: 256→192 (untested smaller). 256g sweet at 0.0438; tested 320g (0.0347), 384g (0.0110), 512g (~0) all higher densities regressed.
